name: McDonald's Hotcakes (Pancakes with Syrup)
whyItWorks: Golden, fluffy white flour pancakes with a soft, spongy texture that dissolves effortlessly in the stomach. Low in dietary fiber and gentle on strictures; paired with maple-flavored syrup for rapid morning energy.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Hotcakes with syrup. Spread a tiny touch of butter or enjoy with just syrup. Skip the sausage patty during active flares.
